lines.text: On Venus, a day is longer than a year.
Venus spins so slowly, it takes two hundred and forty-three Earth days to turn around just once.
lines.caption: Venus spins so slowly, it takes 243 Earth days to turn around just once.

lines.text: But it only needs two hundred and twenty-five days to travel all the way around the Sun.
lines.caption: But it only needs 225 days to travel all the way around the Sun.

lines.text: So its year ends before its day does.
And it gets weirder. Venus spins backwards.
So the Sun rises in the west, and sets in the east.
If you could survive the heat. It's hot enough to melt lead.
Sounds fake? It's true. Follow for more.
